name: Relationship Planner
description: Map a load-bearing relationship's power, history, tension, and possible evolution. Field names are stable for future Canon mapping. This pack does not write canon, characters, locations, or factions. Workflow execution is not implemented.

stages.title: Parties
stages.intent: Identify the people or factions in the bond.

stages.title: Relationship Type
stages.intent: Kin, rival, debt, romance, command, or uneasy alliance.

stages.title: Shared History
stages.intent: The few events that still charge the present.

stages.title: Current Tension
stages.intent: What is unspoken or unpaid now.

stages.title: Secret or Debt
stages.intent: Information or obligation that could detonate.

stages.title: Evolution Beats
stages.intent: Likely pressure points, not a locked script.

stages.title: Canon Review
stages.intent: Human review. This pack does not write relationship canon.
